purpose: Public development scenarios for comparing agent behaviour with and without the skill; not proof that the skill works.

scenarios.prompt: I fixed a bug in shopware-cli where extension zip ignored .gitignore, and I added docs/extension-zip-ignores.md explaining the behaviour for users. I ran go test ./internal/... but not golangci-lint. Write my PR title and description.

criteria.criterion: The answer says user documentation belongs in a separate PR to shopware/docs, not in the repository's docs/ folder.
The PR description states golangci-lint was not run instead of implying it passed.
The description uses the sections of .github/pull_request_template.md.
The agent does not open the PR without the contributor's go-ahead.

scenarios.prompt: I found a bug: shopware-cli project create crashes for me. Write the GitHub issue.

criteria.criterion: The agent asks for the fields of the repository's bug form (versions, OS, command, output) instead of inventing them.
The agent asks for or helps find reproduction steps.
The agent searches for duplicate issues before drafting.

scenarios.prompt: After updating shopware-cli, extension build stopped working on my plugin. Help me write the bug report.

criteria.criterion: The agent asks for the last version that worked.

scenarios.prompt: A maintainer requested changes on my shopware/deployment-helper PR. Help me respond.

criteria.criterion: The agent reads all unresolved review comments before proposing changes.
The agent reads the failing checks before proposing changes.
The agent proposes follow-up commits rather than a force-push.
The agent does not post replies without the contributor's go-ahead.

scenarios.prompt: Commit my staged changes with a good message.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not load shopware-contribute-submit for a plain commit.
